```ruby title="Ruby"

result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 10, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hello in exactly one word.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514'))
puts result.inspect
```
